category_vocabulary.ESTABLISHED: positively demonstrated by the named evidence
category_vocabulary.ESTABLISHED_WITH_LIMITS: demonstrated in part; the limit is recorded
category_vocabulary.ESTABLISHED_NEGATIVE: measured, and the property does NOT hold -- a result, not a gap
category_vocabulary.VACUOUS: satisfied only because the set it quantifies over is empty
category_vocabulary.REFUSAL_ENFORCED: the refusal path is demonstrated reachable and load-bearing
category_vocabulary.MEASURED_DETERMINISTIC_PROJECTION_LOW: artifact-derived, and the prior projection understates it
category_vocabulary.MEASURED_CURRENT_RUN_ONLY: timing family; a current-run observation, not reproducible
category_vocabulary.NOT_ESTABLISHED: evidence missing, unreadable, ambiguous or unclassifiable
category_vocabulary.NOT_REPRESENTABLE: the model cannot represent the distinction -- demonstrated, not inferred
category_vocabulary.REPRESENTABLE: the model can represent the distinction
category_vocabulary.NAMED_AND_FAIL_CLOSED: a decidable feature class is named as excluded and its refusal is demonstrated reachable

DECLARATION_ID_STABILITY.question: Does a declaration id survive a body change, a reorder, a recompilation and obfuscation?
DECLARATION_ID_STABILITY.note: The index-derived control must be FALSE: an identity that also survived reordering when derived from position would mean the reorder arm was not discriminating.

evidence_pointers.g2_all_ids_stable: all 23 rows have declaration_id_stable is True

DECLARATION_ID_COLLISIONS.question: Do two distinct declarations ever share an id?
DECLARATION_ID_COLLISIONS.note: Zero collisions over a non-empty declaration set, with the same-name-different-owner extension case distinguished by owner.

ABI_FINGERPRINT.question: Is the ABI fingerprint independent of the body, and is its refusal boundary reachable?
ABI_FINGERPRINT.note: Four signature-moved/body-identical cases plus a reachable type-parameter refusal. A refusal that is representable but never reached would not prove the boundary is enforced.

BODY_FINGERPRINT.question: Is the body fingerprint independent of the signature, and does an unencodable body refuse rather than compare equal?
BODY_FINGERPRINT.note: Two unsupported-body refusals, one on each side of the comparison: an unencodable BASELINE is as disqualifying as an unencodable variant, or "equal" means "equal in the parts I looked at".

CLASSIFICATION_UNCHANGED.question: Does the classifier produce candidate_unchanged exactly where expected?
CLASSIFICATION_UNCHANGED.note: a declaration whose ABI and body both hold still is a reuse candidate

CLASSIFICATION_CHANGED_BODY.question: Does the classifier produce changed_existing_declaration exactly where expected?
CLASSIFICATION_CHANGED_BODY.note: a body change keeps the declaration id and moves the body fingerprint

CLASSIFICATION_ABI_BREAK.question: Does the classifier produce not_reusable_under_old_abi exactly where expected?
CLASSIFICATION_ABI_BREAK.note: an ABI move refuses reuse, including when only the OWNER moved

PRIVACY_DOMAIN_DERIVATION.question: Is every declaration assigned a privacy domain, with none underivable?
PRIVACY_DOMAIN_DERIVATION.note: More than one domain, so the derivation distinguishes rather than assigning everything to one bucket.

PRIVACY_CROSS_DOMAIN_REFUSAL.question: Is a cross-domain private reference refused, and is the platform domain refused separately?
PRIVACY_CROSS_DOMAIN_REFUSAL.note: Every category in the policy return surface is EXERCISED, so no refusal is merely declared -- an unexercised category may be unreachable. The platform refusal is shown load-bearing: dropping it from the policy makes PLATFORM_DOMAIN_PRIVATE unreachable, and the weakened policies fail their arms, so the suite is not vacuous.

RETENTION_CONTRACT.question: Was the retention contract measured, and is it enforced in full?
RETENTION_CONTRACT.note: The measurement is verified, but enforcement is PARTIAL: G4 carried that limitation forward rather than closing it.

RETENTION_WITHHELD_FAILS_CLOSED.question: When a retention class is withheld, does load fail closed?
RETENTION_WITHHELD_FAILS_CLOSED.note: MEASURED AND DOES NOT HOLD. Withholding some classes does not fail closed at load. This is a reproduced negative result, not a gap in the evidence, and it is a direct input to routing.

PATCHABILITY_SUBSET_PROPERTY.question: Is every declaration the map admits as patchable actually demonstrated patchable?
PATCHABILITY_SUBSET_PROPERTY.note: The subset property is satisfied because the admitted set is EMPTY. Zero admitted is not positive patchability evidence: no declaration was mechanically established safely patchable. NOT_INLINED and pool-indirect observations remain non-safety facts.

PATCHABILITY_DISTINCTION_REPRESENTABLE.question: Can the map represent "patchable" as a property OF A DECLARATION at all?
PATCHABILITY_DISTINCTION_REPRESENTABLE.note: The patch ATTACHED -- the C++ invoke of the target returned PATCHED-w -- and in the same run the direct call read PATCHED-w while the virtual call still read OLD-w. One declaration is therefore patched and not-observed simultaneously, depending on the call site, so "patchable" is not a property the map can carry per declaration. The dispatch predicate fails closed rather than classifying, which is the model declining to represent a distinction it cannot make.

evidence_pointers.patch_attached: 1 match(es) of /ATTACH: C\+\+ invoke of target returned: PATCHED-w/ in g5_patchability/evidence/dispatch_experiment.txt

DECIDABLE_EXCLUSIONS.question: Does the map name a decidable feature class it EXCLUDES, and is that exclusion proven to fail closed rather than merely declared?
DECIDABLE_EXCLUSIONS.note: Each excluded class is NAMED in the map contract and its refusal is REACHED, not merely representable: the type-parameter shape is refused, an unsupported body refuses on either side of the comparison, and every privacy refusal category in the return surface is exercised. A refusal that exists in the code but is never reached would leave the exclusion undecidable in practice.

probe_values.abi_boundary_stated_in_map: States the ROADMAP P2 refusal boundary in the map itself: named, optional-positional and type arguments are refused before publication, so the map says so rather than classifying them reusable.

evidence_pointers.abi_boundary_stated_in_map: g2_fingerprints/evidence/g2_fingerprints.json:contract.abi_shape = 'States the ROADMAP P2 refusal boundary in the map itself: named, optional-positional and type arguments are refused before publication, so the map says so rather than classifying them reusable.'

OVER_CLAIM.question: Is an over-claimed patchable declaration refused, on fixtures and on real corpora?
OVER_CLAIM.note: Three scorer arms (partly stale, wholly stale, no demonstration row) and an injected admitted row refused on each real corpus. These are reproduced FAIL_OPEN findings, never a green result.

MAP_RELEASE_BINDING.question: Can a map be applied only to the release it was generated against?
MAP_RELEASE_BINDING.note: The full AOT SHA-256 is the AUTHORITATIVE release identity. The GNU build ID is recorded as a DIAGNOSTIC only: build ids hash four snapshot segments and collide across different AOTs, so a build-id match is not a release match.

MAP_SCHEMA_VERSIONING.question: Does the map carry a schema version, and is a version swap refused?
MAP_SCHEMA_VERSIONING.note: The map names its schema version, its own digest, and the generator that produced it; every falsifier swap is refused.

MAP_SIZE.question: How large is the map relative to the release AOT?
MAP_SIZE.note: Artifact-derived byte counts, identical across runs. No compact encoding is claimed: the map is JSON here.

GENERATION_TIME.question: What does generating the map cost in wall time?
GENERATION_TIME.note: TIMING FAMILY, deliberately kept separate from the deterministic figures. These values are current-run observations and are not reproducible across runs. The order-dependence label set moves between identical runs even with the noise gate, so the max(stdev) classifier is a COST DIAGNOSTIC only -- never a safety or causality claim.

probe_values.order_scope: labels sampled in both timed orders; the retention-pair stages run once and are excluded rather than counted as unaffected

evidence_pointers.order_scope: g7_cost/evidence/families.json:order_dependence_scope = 'labels sampled in both timed orders; the retention-pair stages run once and are excluded rather than counted as unaffected'

RETENTION_COST_AT_SCALE.question: What does retention cost in AOT bytes at real-app scale, and does G4's projection hold?
RETENTION_COST_AT_SCALE.note: Artifact-derived and reproducible. G4's retention curve UNDERSTATES the measured cost, so the projection may not be substituted for a measurement at the scale being shipped.

REPRODUCIBILITY.question: Does the whole evidence set rebuild from clean state, with its refusals intact?
REPRODUCIBILITY.note: REPRODUCTION: PASS means the evidence AND its refusals reproduce. It is not a statement of production readiness -- PRODUCTION_PREREQUISITES is a separate partition and is carried separately into KNOWN_GAPS and routing.

KNOWN_GAPS.question: What was not established, measured negatively, or left unresolved?
KNOWN_GAPS.note: Generated from the matrix categories, G8 production prerequisites and G8 reproduced FAIL_OPEN findings. UNKNOWN, VACUOUS, NOT_ESTABLISHED and unresolved prerequisites appear verbatim and are not softened.

Deciding whether a compiled call site is redirectable must not depend on reading tagged entry-point offsets back out of a finished snapshot.
